title.en: When and while: past continuous and past simple

ex.ko: 내가 도착했을 때 그는 요리하고 있었어요.
ex.en: When I arrived, he was cooking.

ex.t: Während ich schlief, klingelte das Telefon.
ex.en: While I was sleeping, the phone rang.

ex.ko: 우리가 도착했을 때 비가 오고 있었어요.
ex.en: When we arrived, it was raining.

ex.t: Ich fiel, während ich spazieren ging.
ex.en: I fell while I was walking.

ex.t: Ich sah einen Freund, während ich auf den Bus wartete.
ex.en: I saw a friend while I was waiting for the bus.

ex.t: Ich wachte um sieben Uhr auf.
Ich sah einen Unfall auf der Straße.
ex.en: I saw an accident in the street.

title.en: 'als' (one past event) and 'während' (at the same time)

explain.ko: als는 과거에 한 번 일어난 일, während는 동시에 진행되던 일을 이을 때 씁니다. 둘 다 부문장이므로 동사가 문장 끝에 갑니다: Als ich ankam, kochte er. 한 문장에서 길게 이어지던 일은 Präteritum으로, 짧은 사건도 Präteritum으로 말합니다. plötzlich는 갑자기 일어난 일을 나타냅니다.
explain.en: Als is used for a single event in the past, während for actions at the same time. Both start a subordinate clause, so the verb goes to the end: Als ich ankam, kochte er. Use the Präteritum for both the background and the event. Plötzlich introduces a sudden event.

head: 표현 / Struktur
예 / Beispiel
rows: Während ich schlief, klingelte das Telefon.
Was machtest du, als das Telefon klingelte?

notes.ko: als / während 뒤 부문장: 동사는 끝.
notes.en: After als / während the verb goes last.

notes.ko: 부문장이 앞이면 주절 동사가 바로 뒤: …, kochte er.
notes.en: If the subordinate clause is first, the main verb follows at once.

notes.ko: 과거 한 번의 일에는 als, 'wenn'은 쓰지 않습니다.
notes.en: For a one-off past event use als, not wenn.

lines.t: Was machtest du, als das Telefon klingelte?

trans.ko: (질문) 전화가 울렸을 때 뭐 하고 있었어요?
trans.en: (Question) What were you doing when the phone rang?

lines.t: Ich habe gestern einen Unfall auf der Straße gesehen.
Wirklich? Was hast du gerade gemacht?
Ich wartete auf den Bus. Plötzlich fuhr ein Auto in ein Motorrad.

trans.ko:
A: 어제 길에서 사고를 봤어.
B: 정말? 그때 뭐 하고 있었어?
A: 버스를 기다리고 있었어. 갑자기 차가 오토바이와 부딪쳤어.
B: 다친 사람은 없었어?
trans.en:
A: I saw an accident in the street yesterday.
B: Really? What were you doing?
A: I was waiting for the bus. Suddenly a car hit a motorbike.
B: Was anybody hurt?

lines.t: Gestern Morgen ging ich im Park spazieren. Während ich spazieren ging, sah ich einen Freund. Als wir sprachen, begann es plötzlich zu regnen. Wir liefen nach Hause.

trans.ko: 어제 아침에 나는 공원에서 걷고 있었어요. 걷는 동안 친구를 봤어요. 우리가 이야기하고 있을 때 갑자기 비가 오기 시작했어요. 우리는 집으로 달려갔어요.
trans.en: Yesterday morning I was walking in the park. While I was walking, I saw a friend. When we were talking, it suddenly started to rain. We ran home.

lines.t: Gegen drei Uhr nachmittags. Ich ging gerade spazieren.
Ein blaues Auto fuhr bei Rot über die Ampel.

trans.ko:
직원: 사고는 언제 일어났어요?
손님: 오후 3시쯤이었어요. 저는 걷고 있었어요.
직원: 무엇을 봤어요?
손님: 파란 차가 신호를 무시했어요.
trans.en:
Clerk: When did the accident happen?
Guest: At about three in the afternoon. I was walking.
Clerk: What did you see?
Guest: A blue car went through the red light.

trans.ko: 1) 내가 도착했을 때 그는 요리하고 있었어요. 2) 내가 자는 동안 전화가 울렸어요. 3) 걷다가 넘어졌어요.
trans.en: 1) When I arrived, he was cooking. 2) While I was sleeping, the phone rang. 3) I fell while I was walking.

items.passage: Tom wartete auf den Bus. Dann sah er einen alten Freund. Sie sprachen eine Stunde lang.

trans.ko: 톰은 버스를 기다리고 있었어요. 그때 그는 오랜 친구를 봤어요. 그들은 한 시간 동안 이야기했어요.
trans.en: Tom was waiting for the bus. Then he saw an old friend. They talked for an hour.

prompt.ko: 과거진행형과 과거형으로 어제 일어난 일을 3문장으로 써 보세요 (when / while 사용).
prompt.en: Write 3 sentences about something that happened yesterday using the past continuous and the past simple (with when / while).

task.model: Als ich in der Schule ankam, regnete es. Während ich auf den Bus wartete, sah ich einen Freund. Plötzlich hörte der Regen auf.

model_trans.ko: 내가 학교에 도착했을 때 비가 오고 있었어요. 버스를 기다리는 동안 친구를 봤어요. 갑자기 비가 그쳤어요.
model_trans.en: When I arrived at school, it was raining. While I was waiting for the bus, I saw a friend. Suddenly the rain stopped.
